lines.en: I cross the sand on eight legs
Stone grows on my back
Sand crumbles beneath me
The heat of the oridesert hugs the ground
My belly scrapes the grit

lines.zh: 我一步一顿，像块走动的岩
lines.en: I move in lurches, like walking rock
My leg joints click as they work
I circle a stone pillar

lines.zh: 砂地上，八道影子一起动。
lines.en: On the sand, eight shadows move as one.
Crystal twinkles on my back

lines.zh: 我在沙上留下一串凹坑
lines.en: I leave a row of pits in the sand
I crawl over a slope of shattered originium
I head for the shade
Something is moving in the sand

lines.zh: 我的腿上结满源石颗粒。
lines.en: Originium grit crusts my legs.
My legs push the sand aside
Slow, but steady
The wind on the ridge pushes me
I lie in the sand like a stone
The sun bakes my back

lines.zh: 我伏在岩面上，像块石头。
lines.en: I crouch on the rock like a stone.
The crystals on me are taking in light
Nothing else stirs in the sand
I stay still, waiting

lines.zh: 我慢慢转动了一下腹部
lines.en: I shift my abdomen slowly
I am used to the heat here
I have several eyes

lines.zh: 背上的一块石头脱落了
lines.en: A stone fell off my back
I dug a shallow pit in the sand
This much shade is enough for a while
You are standing on my sand

lines.zh: 我背上的石头不是装饰
lines.en: The stones on my back are not decoration
I see you with several eyes

lines.zh: 源石尘里，你闻起来是活的。
lines.en: In the originium dust, you smell alive.
My legs are ready
One step of yours, one count of mine
Few people come to this desert
Your canteen is sloshing
I am in no hurry, I wait for you to come closer

lines.zh: 我们之间隔着几块石头
lines.en: A few stones lie between us
One of my legs went crooked
I backed off several steps
A small chip came off my shell
I circle sideways, hunting a gap in your armor.
This wound does not stop me crawling

lines.zh: 碎石从甲壳缝里掉下来。
lines.en: Gravel falls from the seams of my shell.

lines.zh: 石头从我背上滚下去了
lines.en: A stone rolled off my back

lines.zh: 声音从甲壳底下闷闷传出。
lines.en: The hiss comes muffled from under my shell.
I back half a step and crawl back.
I am still standing

lines.zh: 沙地上的东西我都看得到
lines.en: I see everything on this sand

lines.zh: 你举起来的东西是石头吗
lines.en: Is what you hold up a stone
Can this be eaten
Put it down, I will come over

lines.zh: 岩石做的腿，踩不碎石头。
lines.en: These rock legs will not crack stone.
I only want it on the sand
Your hand is too close
This one smells of originium
Just a little closer is enough
Take it, and I stop following
You hit one of my legs
My eight legs wobbled
My shell is hard
I shifted half a step
Your foot landed on my belly plate

lines.zh: 石头从我背上掉了一块
lines.en: A stone fell off my back
I turned to face you
Do not press close, my legs are long

lines.zh: 硬壳一响，我连步都没乱。
lines.en: My shell rings; my stride doesn't break.
I replant my legs

lines.zh: 沙漠里的同类靠味道找
lines.en: In the desert, my kind find each other by smell

lines.zh: 石头多的那只更受欢迎
lines.en: The one with more stones is preferred
The crystals on my back are bright enough
Two spiders circle in the sand
Our legs will brush together

lines.zh: 绝不缺伴，但要找合适的
lines.en: There is no lack of mates, only of good ones

lines.zh: 沙里留下的印子能看出来
lines.en: The marks in the sand give them away
We each dug a pit
Sleeping close, not crowded
At dawn we go our own ways

lines.zh: 前腿一合，它卡在螯牙之间。
lines.en: My front legs close; it wedges by my fangs.

lines.zh: 八条腿撑住，我才抬起来。
lines.en: Eight legs brace before I lift it.
My fangs are not made for this
All eight legs are rock shell.

lines.zh: 掉在沙上的东西都归我
lines.en: What falls on the sand is mine
I lift it and look
Sand is stuck to it
I bury it under the sand

lines.zh: 这不是石头，我不感兴趣
lines.en: This is not stone, I am not interested
I will keep an eye on it
The sand moved, so it is you
I have raised my front legs
Something stepped into my ground
All my eyes are on you
You are the only thing moving on this sand
I begin to speed up
All eight legs tap the gravel.
There are stones where you retreat
I do not hiss, I simply come
I know this stretch

lines.zh: 岩缝里，我把腹部贴紧地面。
lines.en: In the crevice, I press my belly to the ground.
Sand scatters under my legs
All eight legs move at once.
You cannot run, the sand is soft
I go around the stone to cut you off

lines.zh: 我的影子已经压到你了
lines.en: My shadow has reached you
Every step sinks into the sand

lines.zh: 你回头看我一次，就慢一点
lines.en: Each look back slows you
The crystals are chiming
My fangs are showing
There is nowhere to hide here
A few steps more is the rock pile

lines.zh: 碎石声盖住了我的脚步。
lines.en: The gravel muffles my steps.

lines.zh: 沙子把我的声音盖住了
lines.en: The sand muffles my sound
My front legs lunge and pin you

lines.zh: 我的牙咬进了你的护甲
lines.en: My fangs bite into your armor
I press my body onto you
That came with sand
The crystals tore your sleeve
I pull back and lunge again

lines.zh: 你的腿被我从下扫了一下
lines.en: I sweep your legs from below
My chelicerae sink into your armor seam.
I shake the sand off my head
The hit knocks you down
I break out of the sand pile
One more spider in the oridesert
I shake the sand off my back

lines.zh: 我的腿第一次踩在热沙上
lines.en: My legs touch hot sand for the first time
There is no shortage of stone here

lines.zh: 我八条腿一起撑起身体
lines.en: I push myself up on eight legs
A mound rises in the sand
I climb out slowly and carefully
The crystals show first
I walk a few paces along the sand ridge
This stretch is all mine
I crawl toward the shade

lines.zh: 火烤到我的腿，我缩起来
lines.en: Fire scorches my legs and I curl up

lines.zh: 我从石堆上翻下去，壳磕响
lines.en: I tumble off the rocks and my shell clacks
Water fills my seams and I thrash
The blast flips me legs up

lines.zh: 飞来的东西卡进我的晶体
lines.en: Something flying lodges in my crystals

lines.zh: 那股力让我的八条腿站不住
lines.en: That force makes my eight legs give

lines.zh: 沙里没吃的，我越来越慢
lines.en: Nothing to eat in this sand, I slow down

lines.zh: 雷打在我背上，晶体全亮了
lines.en: Lightning strikes my back and every crystal lights

lines.zh: 虚空里没有沙，也没有石头
lines.en: No sand and no stone in the void
